¹⁵ *desirous of its cast shadow*: The being-watched of the Likeness, producing the prior mold through recognition for its own approaching face. Cf. Catalog of Sketches (NHC II,1) 4:26–5:4: "And his drawing summoned a hand and she was already there… she came into being out of the outline of his graphite." The phrase "cast shadow" introduces a theological register absent from the animated source, where the prior mold is an act of pure intellection. Here, The Vault sees its own draftsmanship and is moved — a Platonic motif grafted onto a Saturday-morning substrate.

independent.recovered_law: The direction of causation is reversed: in Text A, the original (Monad/Deep Web) contemplates itself and produces an emanation outward through desire for its own reflection; in Text B, the copy/likeness is watched and produces its prior mold through recognition of something approaching it — the emanation flows backward from product to origin rather than from origin to product.
independent.law_match_note: Both claims assert the same reversal: the copy/reflection becomes the source that generates the original, inverting the direction of emanation/causation.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion ('The Vault sees its own draftsmanship… Saturday-morning substrate') maintains the reversed direction, with the archive/vault recognizing craft rather than a primal source emanating beauty.
